mapper.select:
SELECT t_price_scheme.id, t_price_scheme.`status`, t_price_scheme.scheme_no AS schemeNo, t_price_scheme.scheme_name AS schemeName, t_price_scheme.product_class_no AS productClassNo, t_product_class.product_class_name AS productClassName, t_price_scheme.trade_type AS tradeType, t_price_scheme.org_no AS orgNo, t_price_scheme.org_name AS orgName, t_price_scheme.workflowid AS workflowid, t_price_scheme.company_no AS companyNo FROM t_price_scheme LEFT JOIN t_product_class ON t_price_scheme.product_class_no = t_product_class.product_class_no LEFT JOIN t_system_user ON t_price_scheme.create_by = t_system_user.id WHERE t_price_scheme.is_deleted = #{param.deleted} AND t_price_scheme.org_no IN
#{item}
AND t_system_user.user_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{param.userName}, '%')
AND t_price_scheme.`status` LIKE CONCAT('%', #{param.status}, '%')
AND t_price_scheme.scheme_no LIKE CONCAT('%', #{param.schemeNo}, '%')
AND t_price_scheme.scheme_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{param.schemeName}, '%')
AND t_price_scheme.product_class_no LIKE CONCAT('%', #{param.productClassNo}, '%')
AND t_price_scheme.product_class_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{param.productClassName}, '%')
AND t_price_scheme.trade_type LIKE CONCAT('%', #{param.tradeType}, '%')
AND t_price_scheme.org_no LIKE CONCAT('%', #{param.orgNo}, '%')
AND t_price_scheme.org_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{param.orgName}, '%')
ORDER BY t_price_scheme.gmt_modified DESC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO t_price_scheme_item (scheme_no, scheme_item_no, area_name, delivery_place_name, delivery_place_class_name, distribution_way, transport_way, pay_way, currency, gmt_create, gmt_modified, unit) VALUES (#{schemeNo}, #{schemeItemNo}, #{areaName}, #{deliveryPlaceName}, #{deliveryPlaceClassName}, #{distributionWay}, #{transportWay}, #{payWay}, #{currency}, #{gmtCreate}, #{gmtModified}, #{unit})
mapper.update: UPDATE t_price_scheme_item SET t_price_scheme_item.scheme_item_no = #{schemeItemNo}, t_price_scheme_item.area_name = #{areaName}, t_price_scheme_item.delivery_place_name = #{deliveryPlaceName}, t_price_scheme_item.delivery_place_class_name = #{deliveryPlaceClassName}, t_price_scheme_item.distribution_way = #{distributionWay}, t_price_scheme_item.transport_way = #{transportWay}, t_price_scheme_item.pay_way = #{payWay}, t_price_scheme_item.currency = #{currency}, t_price_scheme_item.unit = #{unit} WHERE t_price_scheme_item.id = #{id}
mapper.select: SELECT t_system_sequence.value FROM t_system_sequence WHERE t_system_sequence.code = #{code}
SELECT count(t_price_scheme_item.scheme_item_no) FROM t_price_scheme_item WHERE t_price_scheme_item.scheme_no = #{schemeNo}
mapper.update: UPDATE t_price_scheme SET t_price_scheme.shbz = #{param.approvalStatus}, t_price_scheme.status = '审核完成' WHERE t_price_scheme.id = #{param.id}
mapper.select: SELECT t_system_org.org_no FROM t_system_org WHERE t_system_org.id = ( SELECT t_system_org.parent_id FROM t_system_org WHERE t_system_org.org_no = #{orgNo})

SELECT t_price_scheme_item.area_name AS areaName, t_price_scheme_item.delivery_place_name AS deliveryPlaceName, t_price_scheme_item.delivery_place_class_name AS deliveryPlaceClassName, t_price_scheme_item.distribution_way AS distributionWay, t_price_scheme_item.transport_way AS transportWay, t_price_scheme_item.pay_way AS payWay, t_price_scheme_item.currency, t_price_scheme_item.unit FROM t_price_scheme_item WHERE t_price_scheme_item.is_deleted = 0 AND t_price_scheme_item.scheme_no = #{schemeNo}
